name: Scouting Rings (Least Minor Ring)
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 3rd; Slot ring; Price 600 gp( matched pair); Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This pair of bands are identical, down to the sigil etched on the inside of each.

EFFECTS

The scouting rings allow two way whispered communication between wearers of the rings up to a range of 120 ft. Individuals who are standing within 5 feet of either wearer can hear these messages with a DC 25 Perception check.

The whispered messages do not require a line, instead being able to circumvent barriers, as long as there is an open path between subjects, which lies within the range of the rings.

Magical silence, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal (or a thin sheet of lead), or 3 feet of wood or dirt block the ability of the rings to communicate.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring or Ring Apprentice; Spells message; Cost 300 gp.
